name: Life is Good
source:
You play as character which had to move with his mom and sister to another city. Doesn't take long to realize that something strange is going on. How will main character deal with it is up to player.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/deamos]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名角色，和母亲与妹妹一起搬到另一座城市。没过多久，你就意识到那里发生着奇怪的事情。主人公要如何应对，由玩家决定。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/deamos]Patreon[/url]]
